subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` change its default ambiguous-disconnect behavior from a fresh embedded rerun to fail closed after reattach/replay cannot prove the original terminal outcome?
rationale: This is not a mechanical bug fix alone: it changes stdout/exit behavior, preserves duplicate-side-effect safety at the cost of a result for existing CLI callers, and the linked canonical issue was opened specifically to obtain this policy choice.

options.title: Adopt reattach-first, fail closed
options.body: Make recovery of the original Gateway run the default and require `--rerun-on-ambiguous` for users who explicitly accept duplicate-side-effect risk.

options.title: Preserve automatic fresh reruns
options.body: Keep the existing fresh-session fallback as the default after recovery cannot establish a terminal outcome, accepting that it can duplicate external effects.

options.title: Defer the default change
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical issue has a maintainer decision on the interactive CLI recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt reattach-first, fail closed
recommendation.body: Make recovery of the original Gateway run the default and require `--rerun-on-ambiguous` for users who explicitly accept duplicate-side-effect risk.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current merged abnormal-close fallback behavior and is the strongest available history signal for the replacement policy.
